image_description: A grand, ornate Baroque-style pipe organ installed in a church gallery. The instrument features a symmetrical facade with multiple towers of vertical metal pipes of varying heights, creating a stepped silhouette. The case is elaborately carved and gilded wood with green and gold accents, flanking a central arched window. The organ sits on a white balcony with decorative moldings.
